g.text: py-app-card-abonnement-evoluon-front | type card | trim 85 x 55 mm, bleed 3 mm | status rebuilt
Bron: 22 printbestanden (source/print). Referentie = getrouwe vectorweergave; template = officiele tokenkleuren, 3 mm bleed, variabelen als live tekst. Labels staan in aparte groepen.
Bron: EvoluonPasjes.pdf p1,2 (CMYK; bleed box in bron nee). Template: trim 85 x 55 mm, bleed 3 mm, totaal 91 x 61 mm.
Variabelen: location-name = Evoluon; field-label-1 = Abonnementsnummer:; field-label-2 = Kenteken:

Source has no bleed box (art overshoots the page by 3 to 20 mm); templates are built with 3 mm bleed. Front: the beeldmerk at 1.508x (54.3 x 65.5 mm) runs 20.7 mm off the left, 10.0 mm off the top and 0.5 mm off the bottom; the part beyond the 3 mm bleed lies outside the template viewBox. Back: the source background overshoots the trim only

0.2 mm at the bottom and 3.3 mm at the top; the template runs the navy into 3 mm all round. The watermark is 5 percent (the Phase 1 document said 10 percent). The back lockup is the reverse lockup (white bubble, aqua dot) at 0.511x of the A6 lockup, centred on the card; the tagline is live text so it can be a variable. Card number and plate fields
are blank in print (input fields only).
